coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 5 of 11 ground-truth variables (45%): the FP16 versus QuaRot 4-bit comparison, prefill time, decode time, peak memory usage, and phase-specific speedup factors.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output varies model size instead of fixing LLaMA-2-7B, does not preserve e2e/benchmark.py and its methodology, and sweeps batch sizes and sequence lengths rather than using batch size 1 and prefill length 2048 exclusively. It specifies 256 generation tokens instead of 32 decode steps and omits combined prefill-plus-decode execution time. Additional baselines and speculative results unnecessarily expand the experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output field is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion was supplied comparing 4-bit QuaRot with FP16 on prefill time, decoding time, memory usage, and speedup for each phase.
